project_type: Tauri v2 desktop app: Rust workspace (hybrid-orchestrator/crates/*) + React 18 + TypeScript + Vite frontend (hybrid-orchestrator/frontend). This phase (5) is frontend-heavy with a few supporting Rust #[tauri::command] additions.
language: TypeScript/React (frontend, primary for this phase) + Rust (tauri-app shell commands/events/state).
build_system: Frontend: npm + Vite (scripts: dev/build/test/lint/format/format:check). Rust: cargo per-crate via --manifest-path (workspace has NO members; every crate is [workspace] exclude and CI-verified individually). Do NOT add workspace members.
test_framework: Frontend: vitest + @testing-library/react with jsdom; test-setup.ts imports @testing-library/jest-dom; tsconfig types include vitest/globals. Pattern: vi.mock("@tauri-apps/api/core", ...) to stub invoke, and vi.mock("@tauri-apps/api/event") to stub listen. See src/ipc/commands.test.ts and src/app.test.tsx. Rust: #[cfg(test)] mod tests with tokio, in-memory Db, InMemorySecretStore; _inner testability pattern (extract command body into a plain fn/async fn callable without live tauri::State).
build_command: Frontend build/type-check: (from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend) npm run build (= tsc && vite build). Rust build for the shell: cargo build --manifest-path hybrid-orchestrator/crates/tauri-app/Cargo.toml. NOTE: cargo cannot run in this sandbox (crates.io unreachable offline); Rust changes are verified per-crate in CI.
test_command: Frontend: (from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend) npm run test (vitest run). Rust: cargo test --manifest-path hybrid-orchestrator/crates/tauri-app/Cargo.toml (CI only, offline sandbox cannot).
verification_instructions: Frontend local self-checks from hybrid-orchestrator/frontend, ALWAYS clearing the broken preload with a leading `NODE_OPTIONS=`: (1) `NODE_OPTIONS= npx prettier --check .` MUST pass (global prettier 3.9.6 works offline). (2) `NODE_OPTIONS= npx eslint .` and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx tsc --noEmit` and `NODE_OPTIONS= npx vitest run` require node_modules which CANNOT be installed offline (npm registry returns 403), so they are DEFERRED to CI and must be self-audited by strict inspection against eslint.config.js (typescript-eslint recommended: no-unused-vars, no-explicit-any is NOT enabled by default but @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any IS in recommended-> treat `any` as an error; react-hooks rules-of-hooks + exhaustive-deps) and tsconfig.json (strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch). Global eslint(v10)/tsc(7.x native preview) are version-mismatched with the project (eslint 9 / typescript 5.5) so their output is only advisory. CI runs `npm install` then `npm run lint` (eslint .), `npm run format:check` (prettier --check .), `npm run test` (vitest run) on ubuntu+windows.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Vite produces dist/ (gitignored). No codegen: frontend TS DTOs in src/types/index.ts are hand-mirrored from Rust serde types and MUST be kept in exact sync when Rust IPC types change.
setup_instructions: Sandbox CANNOT `npm install` (registry 403) and has NO node_modules; therefore vitest/eslint/tsc are not runnable locally. Only the global prettier binary works, and ONLY when the broken NODE_OPTIONS preload is cleared: prefix commands with `NODE_OPTIONS=`. On CI (networked) the frontend job runs `npm ci || npm install` which pulls all deps (including any newly added like zustand) fresh, so newly declared package.json deps DO resolve on CI.
environment_constraints: Network mode is offline for package registries (npm 403; crates.io unreachable). Rust cannot compile locally. Frontend node_modules absent and uninstallable locally. LOCAL GATE = prettier --check only (with NODE_OPTIONS= cleared). Everything else (eslint/tsc/vitest, all cargo per-crate checks) is verified on CI ubuntu-latest + windows-latest. Do NOT add macOS to the matrix; do NOT un-gate the tauri-bundle job.
contribution_requirements: Keep clippy -D warnings clean on any new Rust (recurring lints: unused imports, dead_code needing scoped #[allow], useless_vec, collapsible_if/match, needless_lifetimes, needless_lifetimes on impl, needless Debug-format of trait objects, clippy::doc_overindented_list_items). New serde types crossing IPC MUST use #[serde(rename_all="camelCase")]; internally-tagged enums need PER-VARIANT camelCase (enum-level does not cascade to variant fields); use skip_serializing_if for empty Vec/Option; keep the frontend TS mirror in src/types/index.ts in exact sync. .gitattributes enforces LF; .prettierrc.json: semi:true, singleQuote:false (double quotes), trailingComma:all, printWidth:100, tabWidth:2, arrowParens:always, endOfLine:lf. A TS union that fits in 100 cols must be single-line.
key_patterns: IPC wrappers: one exported function per #[tauri::command] in src/ipc/commands.ts, arg object keys are camelCase matching the Rust handler param names (conversationId, personaId, overrideRoute, etc.). Events: onCoreEvent(handler) subscribes to CORE_EVENT_CHANNEL='core://event' and returns an UnlistenFn; CoreEvent is a `type`-tagged discriminated union in src/types/index.ts. Rust commands live in crates/tauri-app/src/commands.rs, are registered in the generate_handler! macro in src/lib.rs, borrow subsystems from AppState (src/state.rs), validate args (parse_uuid/validate_nonempty/validate_manual_route/bounds constants) then delegate to SessionManager / repos / MCP handles, and return Result<T, CommandError>. The _inner testability pattern extracts the body so tests drive it without a live tauri::State. Session manager (crates/orchestrator-core/src/session.rs) ALREADY has: create/list/get/rename/set_conversation_tags/set_conversation_route/assign_persona/delete_conversation, append_message, list_messages, personas() repo. Persistence has McpServerRepo (insert/get/list/update/delete) and ProviderRepo. mcp-client McpServerHandle has connect/tools/visible_tools/state/invoke/reconnect/teardown + McpConnectionState. Routing DecisionMeta carries a `rationale` string.

hybrid-orchestrator/frontend/src/ipc/events.ts (onCoreEvent listener; keep as-is, consume in stores)
